retrieved.text: Official who may allow a scribe on the Dean’s recommendation: Controller of Examinations. Exam venue for candidates using a scribe: A separate room or the wellness centre. Writing-hand injury criterion for scribe assistance: An injury that prevents writing.

Final approval authority for moderated exam results: Vice-Chancellor. Portal on which faculty enter exam and assessment marks: ERP. Stage at which the grade report is generated: After grades are locked in the ERP.

University ticket system for examination grievances: BU Helpdesk. Channel used to acknowledge an exam grievance: The submission channel. Person asked to verify an allegedly out-of-syllabus question: Course coordinator.

Students normally have 15 days from announcement of results to submit the prescribed re-evaluation form to the Controller of Examinations and pay the applicable fee. The manual lists a non-refundable charge of ₹5,000 for each subject, subject to changes in university policy. Incomplete forms can be rejected.

Exam route for backlog courses in a one-year programme: Special supplementary examination. Non-refundable supplementary fee for batches starting in 2024–25: ₹3,000 per course, subject to change. Frequency of regular supplementary exams for recently completed semesters: Twice in an academic year.
